text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...It might be nice to venture out
and visit a faraway planetarium once in a while.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Where should I go on my next day off, I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Admire Vega
thoroughly enjoyed her day off!
